mines.mine_notes: Surface gold tailings retreatment extending from central Johannesburg to Ekurhuleni. 19.487 Mt processed @ yield 0.178 g/t (FY24: 16.101 Mt @ 0.226 g/t); 5% lower production on depleted higher-grade clean-up sites, shift to high-throughput/low-yield profile. Cash cost converted from R1,064,447/kg. Brakpan TSF approaching final phase; recommissioning adjacent Withok TSF (310 Mt capacity, ~20-year life at 1.3 Mtpm) planned in next 3–4 years. Ergo LoM 22 years. Crown Complex added to reserves in FY25.
mines.processing: Ergo plant (1.9 Mtpm) + Knights and City Deep milling plants; CIL

mines.mine_notes: Surface gold tailings retreatment on the Far West Rand (Westonaria/Fochville/Carletonville). 6.126 Mt processed @ yield 0.222 g/t; steady-state performance. Cash cost converted from R492,049/kg. DP2 plant expansion (to double throughput) + regional tailings storage facility (RTSF, 800 Mt, one-third completed Q1 FY2027) underway; Driefontein 4 TSF in final stages of operating life. FWGR LoM 16 years.
mines.processing: Driefontein 2 plant (600 ktpm) + DP2 plant; CIL

notes: Fiscal year ends 30 June. FY2025 group: 25.613 Mt milled, yield 0.189 g/t, gold produced 155,288 oz (4,830 kg; FY24: 160,818 oz); gold sold 154,902 oz. All-in sustaining costs US$1,716/oz (FY24: $1,575/oz); cash operating costs US$1,549/oz; average price received US$2,797/oz. USD conversions of mine-level cash costs derived from reported R/kg using the report's own implied conversion (R1,632,275/kg = US$2,797/oz); the company files on JSE, A2X and NYSE (DRD). Group sustaining capex R300.6M. 60 MW solar PV + 160 MWh BESS at Ergo. Mineral reserves price R1,689,997/kg (US$2,982/oz @ R17.63/US$). No dividend reinvestment; 70 cps dividends declared for FY2025 (final 40 cps doubled).
